newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed as crude fall pressures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed as crude fall pressures.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline fell with futures although sales to the U.S. have been supported. Naphtha was softer with crude. Vitol won most of an Egyptian 55-cargo sales tender over six months.
Gas oil was weaker with futures and ample supplies. Low sulphur came under pressure as Med cargoes and slack demand continued to eat away at premiums.
High sulphur fuel defied the slump in the product complex wrought by crude's dump and gained $1 to $83/$85 in thin trade. Low sulphur was quiet as traders waited for crude to settle.
